# Community rules
Be respectful. No harassment, bullying, threats or hate speech.
Keep it appropriate. No NSFW, violent or shocking content (Suggestive content allowed if still rule complient).
No spam. Do not flood the site with repeated posts, comments or messages.
Be honest. No impersonation or deliberately false information.
Use the report button instead of retaliating. Developers review every report.
# Moderation
Posts reported by 5 different people are hidden until a developer reviews them. Verified users can also hide a post for review.
Developers may remove posts or comments that break these rules.
